target_definition: ln(AdjClose_week_end(t+1) / AdjClose_week_end(t)); next week's final trading-day adjusted Close divided by this week's final trading-day adjusted Close. Label only, not a model input.

target_alignment.note: Rows are unverifiable inside this factor file when a ticker is absent in the next weekly cross-section or when the row is the ticker's final observation.
